It does not enumerate the constitutive models requested for soil, such as the Material table ground-material inventory. Shared words in its header are insufficient to make it an equivalent source.

limitations: Seven semantic prompts reuse one target and two repeats; this is not a broad routing accuracy estimate or independent 16-question cohort.
The local baseline uses only the original question and does not reproduce actual RAG bilingual translation/planning; 4/16 is not full production RAG recall or answer accuracy.
The fixed-en rows are lexical skips: 16/16 Responses includes two rows with no Responses call; the genuine endpoint result is 14/14.
Only source choice is evaluated. No generated answers, sufficiency audit, hallucination rate, end-to-end speedup, provider cost, P95 or SLA is established.
Decisions and Responses use their actual production service protocols; their shared question/candidate bytes match, while endpoint request structures differ.

Warm catalog/source validation is excluded from row timing; total client-call timing is separately retained. The unusually high first off construction time is client setup, not local lexical retrieval latency.
Wrong choice is a scoped, source-validated literal table, not invented source content. Revalidation does not establish semantic relevance or completeness.
